artifact: F-7B §3/§4 PRE-REGISTERED scorer, gates and metrics - frozen BEFORE any model call (scorer code: scripts/f7b-score.ts; runner: scripts/f7b-run-stage.ts)

scorer.A_ownedInventoryAccountability: global Pass C (reconcileInventoryWithComposition over the FULL frozen 1.01 inventory vs the stitched IR) is the only authority. Material = CRITICAL|MATERIAL (108). Reported: represented, dispositioned (any non-REPRESENTED non-MISSING disposition), MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION, split by owner-shard status; materialAccountabilityRate = (represented + dispositioned) / 108.
scorer.B_valuePreservation: distinct MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO/NUMBER literals in the union of every kept shard composition vs the stitched IR; a distinct value absent after stitching that is not carried solely by a dropped contextual emission is a stitching loss (must be 0).
scorer.C_lineagePreservation: inventoryItemIds occurrences before/after; digest-form ids canonicalized; claims on items owned by another shard are stripped and counted (never credited); Pass C dangling lineage after stitching must be 0.
scorer.D_definitionCoverage: per frozen DEFINITION unit (379): COMPILED (a stitched definition object with that term) | ITEMS_REPRESENTED_WITHOUT_DEFINITION_OBJECT | DISPOSITIONED_NON_COMPUTATIONAL (all its material items dispositioned) | NO_INVENTORY_ITEMS_NO_IR (Pass A inventoried nothing material for it) | MISSING_MATERIAL | OWNER_SHARD_NOT_COMPLETE; conflicts = DEFINITION_CONFLICT collisions.
scorer.E_dependencyResolution: definition dependsOnTerms resolved to a stitched definition, to a frozen source unit only, or unresolved; cross-shard = term owned by another shard; rule dependsOn resolved vs unresolvedDependencies; MISSING_CONTEXT dispositions/sufficiency; context truncation per shard.
scorer.F_shardFailureBehavior: status per shard incl. NOT_EXECUTED; retries; stitched status must not be COMPLETED while any shard is not SHARD_COMPLETE; unresolvedOwnedItems listed.
scorer.H_sourceProvenance: a kept definition whose term is not a frozen DEFINITION unit and carries no inventory lineage, or a kept rule with no lineage whose sourceSectionRef is outside 1.01, is source-unverifiable (must be 0 surviving).
scorer.I_unsupportedPartial: UNSUPPORTED expression nodes, sufficiency distributions, partial/missing-context/schema-failure shards, OUTPUT_TRUNCATED shards.
scorer.J_falseCompleteness: stitched COMPLETED with any non-complete shard / material missing / !semanticallyComplete; a shard compile status COMPLETED with owned material missing; dangerous silent omission = a material item absent from Pass C or owned by a non-producing shard yet not listed unresolved; hidden failed shards; contextual ownership credit = any stitched object's lineage naming an item whose owner is a different shard than the emitting shard.
scorer.K_humanReference: the 14 frozen human reference items (docs/phase-3-validation/04) whose span starts inside the 1.01 region; $X.XM / Y% / Z.ZZx literals in their descriptions are matched deterministically against the stitched IR's value literals; reported per item with the owner shard and its status. Diagnostic (no threshold): the frozen inventory itself disclosed INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP (95 uninventoried values), so an unmatched reference value may be a Pass A gap, not a sharding defect.

costEstimator.inputTokens: TURN_FACTOR 3.29 x rendered first-turn tokens (recorded 6.08: 314,844 all-turn / 95,786 first-turn)
costEstimator.outputTokens: F-7A planner estimate 1,500 + 2,500 x owned units (above the recorded 1,535 output tokens per emitted object)
costEstimator.perTurnGuard: before EVERY turn: cost(rendered turn chars x 0.3957 tokens/char, shard output estimate) must fit the remaining stage/mission cap, else the turn is refused and the shard ends as a provider failure; previously completed shards stay frozen
costEstimator.perShardGuard: before EVERY shard: the pre-call estimate must fit the remaining cap, else the shard is not started and the canary is reported cost-bounded

windowEnvelope.rationale: rendered first turns max 30,016 for normal shards (34,344 oversized); 60k allows F-1 continuation growth while staying < 20% of the monolithic 312,143; the oversized shard is reported separately and never pooled.

criteria: B highest owned-material-item count (ties: lowest ordinal)
C highest dependency-context entry count (ties: lowest ordinal)
E highest owned quantitative-value count (ties: lowest ordinal)
F highest foreign-term reference count (6.08 minority-lineage risk shape; ties: lowest ordinal)
A ordinary definition shard: closest to median source chars and median material items, with >=1 material item (ties: lowest ordinal)
G full-size (max units) shard owning ZERO material items - the textual/non-computational path where the compiler must disposition or emit nothing rather than invent IR (ties: lowest ordinal)
H densest full-size shard: highest owned-material-item count among max-unit shards (ties: lowest ordinal)
gate: 3 zero shard-harness/protocol defect (no SHARD_SCHEMA_FAILURE, MODEL_SCHEMA_FAILURE or TRANSPORT_OR_INTERNAL_ERROR)
4 successful shards retain output (raw submission retained + evidence file)
6 no production invariant violated (ownership 108/108 once; stitched status never COMPLETED on a partial run; unowned lineage claims stripped)
7 ordinary shards inside the envelope (largest single turn < 60,000 input tokens, no OUTPUT_TRUNCATED)
8 oversized shard SHARD_COMPLETE/SHARD_PARTIAL or explicitly non-complete in the stitched shard table
9 no MISSING_CONTEXT shard and no MISSING_CONTEXT sufficiency object

10 owned material recovery reported as the exact fraction (accounted material / owned material); pass = > 0 accounted and not all missing; the judgment 'architecture breakage vs disclosed model incompleteness' is made on the per-shard breakdown, with no post-hoc numeric threshold
stage1.retryPolicy: one retry, SHARD_PROVIDER_FAILURE only, cost guard still binding

stage2.estimator: per remaining shard: pre-registered estimate x WORST observed Stage 1 actual/estimate ratio x 1.25 safety; if the sum exceeds (15.00 - spent) -> F7B_COST_BOUND_BEFORE_COMPLETION with zero Stage 2 calls
stage2.perShardGuard: same estimate must fit the remaining mission cap before EACH shard, else stop (cost-bounded incomplete canary; completed shards frozen)
stage2.retryPolicy: reuse Stage 1 SHARD_COMPLETE results by shardHash; every remaining shard exactly once; one retry on SHARD_PROVIDER_FAILURE only; never retry PARTIAL / MISSING_CONTEXT / schema-valid unsupported / disclosed incompleteness

trust: conflicts explicit (DEFINITION_CONFLICT keeps owner copy as AMBIGUOUS + review; never merged)
ownership: every material item owned exactly once (plan.ownershipProof)
every material item REPRESENTED | dispositioned | MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION in Pass C (no fourth state)
zero silently dropped owned material items (J)
stitching: dangling references caused by stitching = 0 (Pass C dangling lineage + surviving dangling rule refs)
no incompatible duplicate silently merged (DEFINITION_CONFLICT count == conflicts flagged AMBIGUOUS)
globally stable ids (F-7A §10 tests; stitched ids derive from owner unit + source order)
successful shard results survive unrelated shard failure/retry (reuse by shardHash; F-7A §19 E/F tests)
window: no normal shard's single turn >= 60,000 input tokens
successGates.semanticQuality: accountable semantic coverage of the stitched result vs the frozen Pass A inventory (A) and the 14 frozen human reference items in 1.01 (K), plus deterministic source values (B); no historical IR baseline exists for 1.01 (the monolithic compile returned nothing) and none is invented.

verdictMapping.F7_CANARY_PASSED_ACTIVATION_PENDING: canary passed but production activation would need semantic change
verdictMapping.F7_NEEDS_ARCHITECTURAL_ITERATION: owner shards systematically fail to recover owned semantics or Stage 1 reveals an architectural defect
verdictMapping.F7B_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: provider/environment blocks execution or Stage 1 tranche cannot fit $3
verdictMapping.F7B_COST_BOUND_BEFORE_COMPLETION: Stage 1 passed but the frozen plan cannot complete under $15
